headline: Contested Fronts Register Fresh Base Turnover
war_summary: The latest ledger finds the war still without a victor on Day 245, with movement concentrated across a handful of contested sectors. Weathered Expanse remains the busiest divided front: 28 base events are recorded in 24 hours, including 11 in the latest two-hour window, while its four Warden and five Colonial holdings sit amid sharply rising casualty rates. Godcrofts has the largest turnover count, with 73 events, though all nine bases currently remain Colonial-held; one event was logged in the latest two hours. Fisherman’s Row records 37 daily events but has gone quiet in the last six hours, with all nine bases presently Colonial. Stonecradle and Stlican Shelf remain split four to five, posting 16 and 27 events respectively, though neither shows a fresh two-hour event. Linn Mercy is another active divided sector, with 12 daily events, three in the latest two hours, and ownership standing at one Warden base to ten Colonial. Deadlands has also seen renewed late activity, six events in 24 hours and three in the latest two hours, centered on Callahan’s Gate.
